offering_description.value: Designs and markets UGG, HOKA and Teva footwear, apparel and accessories for consumers and retailers worldwide. Products are made by outside contract manufacturers and sold through wholesale accounts, its own stores and its website.

customer_segment.value: B2C: consumers buying through its website and own stores; B2B: department stores, specialty and sporting goods retailers, and international distributors

end_markets.value: consumer footwear; outdoor and athletic apparel; fashion retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: footwear and apparel sold wholesale to retailers and directly to consumers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets products made by contract factories, sold to retailers and consumers; retailer: sells directly to consumers through its own stores and website

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets, with the US the largest

specialization.value: related lines: UGG, HOKA and Teva footwear and apparel lines sharing retail channels and customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: wholesale sales to retail accounts; own locations: company-operated retail stores; online: company website direct-to-consumer sales; third-party retail: department stores, specialty and sporting goods retailers; distributors / dealers: independent international distributors
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; online; third-party retail; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety, labeling, customs and tariff rules for footwear and apparel imports

notes: The brand portfolio may have changed, so smaller or divested brands are not described.
